description: This Java source file defines the ShipmentWorker class, which contains utility methods related to shipment processing in the Apache OFBiz framework. The methods include calculating shipment package content values, splitting packages based on weight constraints, calculating package weight, and retrieving product information.

classes.name: ShipmentWorker
classes.description: Final utility class providing shipment-related methods for calculations and package management in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getShipmentPackageContentValue
methods.description: Calculates the value of a shipment package content by averaging the value of its item issuances divided by issued quantities, then multiplying by the content quantity.

methods.name: getPackageSplit
methods.description: Splits shippable items into multiple packages based on maximum weight constraints, grouping items appropriately.

methods.name: calcPackageWeight
methods.description: Calculates the total weight of a package by summing the weight of individual products, converting UOM if necessary.

methods.name: getProductItemInfo
methods.description: Retrieves product information from a list of item info maps based on product ID.
